{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print("Duplicate patient_id (before dropping sample_seq):", trial_df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Drop duplicates based on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
trial_df_clean = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Verify the clean shape
print("Clean shape:", trial_df_clean.shape)

# Check the distribution of severity across arms
print("Severity distribution by arm:\n", trial_df_clean.groupby(['arm', 'severity']).size().unstack(fill_value=0))
